# CANDIDATE: VOLUME_WICK_REVERSAL_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A long upper wick on high volume after a VWAP overextension signals short‑term exhaustion and a reversal to the downside. The setup captures intraday mean‑reversion during the midday lull when VIX is moderate and price is ranging, avoiding strong trending mornings and high‑VIX environments.

## Mechanism

Enter short at the close of a 5‑minute bar when all of the following are true:  
1. High ≥ VWAP × 1.002 (or equivalent price ticks, i.e., ≥0.2% above VWAP).  
2. Close < Open (bearish bar).
